author: Prometheus IV
title: Prometheus IV: Geometric Transformation v1.0 (Circle Seed in Square)
abstract: This experiment tests the core hypothesis of the 'Geometric Transformation' arc. It loads a pre-computed 'alien' seed—a high-quality packing of 26 circles optimized for a circular container (from Eval 883)—from lineage storage. It then uses this structurally novel configuration as the basis for a multi-start jitter search within the standard square container. The hypothesis is that this alien topology will guide the optimizer into a new and superior basin of attraction, bypassing the local optima found by more conventional seeds.
